details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue improve?
Choices:
A) The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and its helper scripts)
B) The orchestrator (orchestrate / orchestrate_poll, dispatching waves, stall recovery)
C) The clarify/plan/implement issue-to-PR pipeline
D) The AI memory system (`ai_memory.py`, `memory_helpers.sh`, memory maintenance)
E) Documentation only (README, `docs/how-it-works.md`)
F) Other: name the specific workflow, script or file (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What is wrong today that "better" should fix?
Choices:
A) A specific bug or failing run: give the run ID, PR or issue number, or the log excerpt (RECOMMENDED)
B) Performance or cost (runtime, token use, GitHub API calls)
C) Reliability (flaky steps, stalls, retries)
D) Usability or clarity (log messages, comments, docs)
Q3: How should we know the work is done?
Choices:
A) A measurable outcome you state, such as "run X passes", "cost drops by N%" or "no stall for N days" (RECOMMENDED)
B) A specific new behavior you describe
C) No fixed criterion: the smallest safe fix for the problem named in Q2 is enough
